content_of_post_to_answer: What is one photo you look at whenever you need to feel better?
answer: For me, the most comforting photos aren't necessarily of happy moments, but of ordinary days I didn't realize I would miss. A familiar face, an old room, people laughing without posing. Looking at them reminds me that happiness often feels ordinary while we're living it. I've explored this idea a little more on my profile, because photographs don't just preserve memories; they reveal what time has taught us to value.
